description: Positive fuzzy displacement with stochastic point placement and full-loop versus bounded scarf distance.

mutants.description: Remove the displacement mode transverse offset. The deterministic Perlin displacement case requires a positive interior offset while preserving the reference width envelope.
Ignore seam_slope_entire_loop. The full-loop row must report a scarf distance strictly longer than the bounded 4 mm row.
Always cap the scarf to seam_slope_min_length. The true entire-loop row then collapses to the bounded row and fails its public statistics oracle.
mutants.old: const double slope_min_length         = slope_entire_loop ? loop_length : std::min(m_config.seam_slope_min_length.value, loop_length);
